answer.explanation: The visible log events show normal execution across all four functions: no errors, timeouts, throttles or permission failures. Durations are stable within each function (Uploader about 80-100 ms at 256 MB, CrudApi about 25-45 ms at 256 MB, Thumbnailer about 90-120 ms at 1024 MB, Compression about 500-650 ms at 1024 MB). Max memory use stays well below the configured sizes (about 91-101 MB for CrudApi, Uploader and Compression, about 106 MB for Thumbnailer), so there is no memory pressure. Compression and Thumbnailer are over-provisioned relative to observed usage, but that is a cost observation, not a configuration anomaly. Caveat: about 4,213 events were truncated, so the rest of the window was not inspected and this conclusion covers only the visible portion.
